title: Roast rhubarb with gammon and eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Rhubarb, orange, honey, olive oil, gammon steaks, eggs and thyme are all plain home ingredients with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Gammon steaks, rhubarb in May, oranges, honey and eggs are all everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only one large roasting tray and simple chopping, zesting and egg cracking.

works.reason: Eggs cracked into gaps on a flat tray awash with a whole orange's juice and rhubarb liquid will run into the syrup rather than set neatly, and 4cm rhubarb roasted for 20 to 22 minutes at 220°C will collapse to mush and may catch with the honey.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes covers chopping the rhubarb, zesting and juicing the orange, picking thyme and snipping the gammon, and 12 plus 8 to 10 minutes matches the 22 printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including thyme and black pepper, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Early May rhubarb is a main part of the dish as a sticky roasted sauce for the gammon, which suits a spring morning.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Gammon, eggs and roast fruit make a proper protein-led cooked breakfast with only a little honey.
